description_en: Upgrades the minor engine version of a specified AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instance
description_zh: 为指定AnalyticDB PostgreSQL版实例升级内核小版本
kebab_example: aliyun gpdb upgrade-db-version --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id gp-wz9kmr708m155j000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpgradeDBVersion

parameters.help_en:
The region ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html operation to query available region IDs
parameters.help_zh:
地域ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86912.html接口查看可用的地域ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The instance ID.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html operation to query the details of all AnalyticDB for PostgreSQL instances in the specified region, including instance IDs
parameters.help_zh:
实例ID。

您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/86911.html接口查看目标地域下所有的AnalyticDB PostgreSQL实例的详情，包括实例ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

The effective period. Valid values:
Immediate (default): The upgrade takes effect immediately.
MaintainTime: The upgrade takes effect during the O&M window. For more information, see ModifyDBInstanceMaintainTime
